title: Ultra Crispy German Pork Flatbread
description: A rich and crispy German dish featuring white wine and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add white wine to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it ferment in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the fermented dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with caraway seeds and black pepper.
Arrange the sliced pork belly on top of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the pork is crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
